learningObjective: Define TPOT (Time Per Output Token) and distinguish it from TTFT and throughput.
stem: Which definition of TPOT (Time Per Output Token, also called inter-token latency) is correct?

options.text: TPOT is the total generation time (TTFT plus all decode steps) divided by the total number of output tokens; it is therefore equal to end-to-end latency per output token including the prefill amortization.
TPOT is the server's overall tokens-per-second throughput divided by the number of concurrent requests; it is a purely server-level metric that has no per-request interpretation.

TPOT is the average wall-clock time between consecutive output tokens after the first token, per request. It excludes TTFT and captures how fast the decode phase runs; for a request generating M tokens, total latency ≈ TTFT + (M-1) * TPOT.
TPOT is the elapsed time of the prefill phase divided by the number of prompt tokens; it measures per-prompt-token processing efficiency.

explanation: TPOT (Time Per Output Token), also called inter-token latency, is the average wall-clock gap between successive output tokens after the first, per request. Total per-request latency = TTFT + (M-1) * TPOT for an M-token response. TPOT reflects decode-phase speed and is user-perceived as generation smoothness; it is directly bounded by KV-cache read bandwidth on batch-1 decode.

optionExplanations.A: Wrong: conflates TTFT and TPOT; TPOT excludes TTFT by convention.
optionExplanations.B: Wrong: describes throughput per concurrent user, not TPOT.
optionExplanations.D: Wrong: describes a prefill-phase efficiency metric, not TPOT.

assumptions: 'After the first token' is the standard convention; some tools compute TPOT including the first token.
Metric is per request; server-side aggregations report averages / percentiles.
nonImplications: Does not imply TPOT alone determines user experience; TTFT and total latency also matter.
Does not imply TPOT is constant across steps; long-context decode can slow down as KV grows.

distractorRationales.D: Confuses with a prefill efficiency metric.
